newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian shares ponder near future as Dow stalls.
newsitem.headline: Belgian shares ponder near future as Dow stalls.

text.p: Belgian shares drifted aimlessly in quiet pre-weekend business on Friday as players wondered what the Dow's next move would be.
"Now there's uncertainty again, people don't know whether the rise will continue," said Patricia Decolvenaer at De Maertelaere.
At 0830 GMT the Bel-20 was down a modest 0.33 percent, or 7.44 points, at 2,216.05 with barely 220 million francs worth of Belgian shares traded.
Dealers cited a touch of profit-taking after Thursday's record run and weaker bonds as the culprits.
Decolvenaer said that in the absence of any other features, investors started eyeing the EMU issue again, wondering whether it would start on time and who would qualify.
She noted neighbouring markets were also dealt soft blows but the trend in Europe was fundamentally "fairly positive".
"We will not start falling," she said.
Shares were trading in a tight range with volatile steel maker Cockerill Sambre the main early loser. It was down 1.5 percent at 130 francs.
